test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Ramesh wants to visit his childhood friend’s house. Ramesh’s friend explained his house directions over a text message. See the below text sent to Ramesh about the direction of his friend’s house and answer the following question accordingly. “When you step out of your house, you are facing north. Take a right and walk 3 km, you will see a T-point/junction. Take a right and walk 2 km. There will be a roundabout with four roads. Take the second left from the roundabout and walk 1 km. Take a right and walk 3 km. Take a right and walk 1 km. You will find my house at the front.” In which direction is Ramesh facing when he takes the second left from the roundabout?
solution:
Given: Ramesh wants to visit his childhood friend’s house. Ramesh’s friend explained his house directions over a text message.

When you step out of your house, you are facing north.

Take a right and walk 3 km, you will see a T-point/junction.

Take a right and walk 2 km. There will be a roundabout with four roads. 

Take the second left from the roundabout and walk 1 km. 

Take a right and walk 3 km. 

Take a right and walk 1 km. You will find my house at the front.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd8ef9fc1f2fec7b9645a925e17b711243cd99f376b0cfbcb1afb7798d5c5ce.png] 

Thus, Ramesh is facing in the south direction when he takes the second left from the roundabout.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here, specifically "Roundabout" is mentioned, so accordingly counting clockwise from the roundabout - 2nd left will be in the south direction.

Furthermore, it is also mentioned "There will be a roundabout with four roads.", so 4 roads are of the four direction, therefore at the roundabout when counted clockwise:

Ramesh (Facing south) → 1st road

1st left (east) → 2nd road

2nd left (south) → 3rd road

3rd left (west) → 4th road
